name: face_voice_triplet

projection.constructor: original1024-per-side constructor, then face Linear1536 and voice Linear1280 replacements

training.negative_rule: different identity, same source, uniformly without replacement; use all if fewer than 16
training.loss: 2*(weighted face-anchor hinge mean + weighted voice-anchor hinge mean)
training.anchor_weight: all-batch different-identity count, normalized across anchors with legal within-source negatives
training.BN: native complete-English-training running mean and variance; no recalibration

deployment.no_gender: float64 L2 of native eval output; raw own branch space
deployment.gender: three stored own-space INLP directions, sequential removal and L2

config_role: Recorded immutable production recipe; the original training body is executed by scripts/train_triplet.py rather than generated from this JSON.
